findings.body: The forced-ASCII test verifies UTF-8 stdin and stderr, but its stdout assertions check only ASCII. `ready()` creates stories with an ASCII title (tests/test_story.py:90,98), and approval prints that stored title (src/forge/approval.py:138–143), so the Unicode document does not exercise stdout encoding. The existing Codex test cannot cover this gap because src/forge/codex.py:131 independently reconfigures stdout. Leaving CLI stdout at its previous encoding with replacement enabled would still pass these tests. Exercise a command that prints a Unicode title under the forced encoding and assert the exact Unicode output.
findings.title: Not done: UTF-8 stdout regression test

findings.body: Using `next()` assigns a reported check to only one required name. With `checks = ["tests", "tests (windows-latest)"]`, a successful Windows check populates only the `tests` group; the explicitly named Windows group remains empty. Close consequently times out reporting a missing check even when every check succeeded. Populate every matching requirement while retaining the checks for unnamed jobs.
findings.title: Count each check toward every matching requirement
